mapper.sql: SELECT CAMPAIGN_ID FROM CAMPAIGN WHERE STORE_ID = #{storeId} AND CAMPAIGN_ID = #{campaignId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.CAMPAIGN_ID, c.STORE_ID, c.GOAL_CODE, c.CUSTOM_GOAL, g.GOAL_NAME, c.INSIGHT_ID, c.CAMPAIGN_NAME, c.TARGET_CUSTOMER, c.TONE_MANNER, c.EXTRA_NOTE, DECODE(c.HASHTAG_YN, 'Y', 1, 0) AS HASHTAG_ON, DECODE(c.CAPTION_YN, 'Y', 1, 0) AS CAPTION_ON, DECODE(c.AD_IMAGE_YN, 'Y', 1, 0) AS IMAGE_ON, c.CURRENT_STEP, c.LOCKED_STEP, c.USAGE_MONTH, c.CAMPAIGN_STATUS, c.CREATED_AT, c.UPDATED_AT, c.PUBLISHED_AT FROM CAMPAIGN c LEFT JOIN GOAL g ON g.GOAL_CODE = c.GOAL_CODE WHERE c.STORE_ID = #{storeId} AND c.CAMPAIGN_ID = #{campaignId}
SELECT CAMPAIGN_ID, PRODUCT_ID FROM CAMPAIGN_PRODUCT WHERE CAMPAIGN_ID IN () ORDER BY CAMPAIGN_ID, PRODUCT_ID

SELECT cc.CAMPAIGN_ID, cc.CHANNEL_CODE, ch.CHANNEL_NAME, cc.CUSTOM_CHANNEL_NAME, cc.CUSTOM_CHANNEL_NOTE, cc.IMAGE_RATIO FROM CAMPAIGN_CHANNEL cc JOIN CHANNEL ch ON ch.CHANNEL_CODE = cc.CHANNEL_CODE WHERE cc.CAMPAIGN_ID IN () ORDER BY cc.CAMPAIGN_ID, ch.SORT_ORDER

SELECT p.AI_PLAN_ID, p.CAMPAIGN_ID, p.VERSION_NO, p.PLAN_SOURCE, p.DIRECTION, p.TARGET_ANALYSIS, p.AGE_GROUP, p.STRATEGY, p.TONES, p.RECOMMENDED_CHANNELS, p.EXPECTED_EFFECT, p.REACH, p.FREQUENCY, p.DURATION, p.USER_REQUEST, DECODE(p.CONFIRMED_YN, 'Y', 1, 0) AS CONFIRMED FROM AI_PLAN p WHERE p.CAMPAIGN_ID IN () AND p.VERSION_NO = (SELECT MAX(x.VERSION_NO) FROM AI_PLAN x WHERE x.CAMPAIGN_ID = p.CAMPAIGN_ID)
SELECT CAMPAIGN_ID, PURPOSE, MAIN_PRODUCT, MOOD, COMPOSITION, DECODE(BRAND_COLOR_YN, 'Y', 1, 0) AS BRAND_COLOR_ON, REFERENCE_IMAGE_URL, EXTRA_REQUEST FROM IMAGE_SETTING WHERE CAMPAIGN_ID IN ()
SELECT DRAFT_ID, CAMPAIGN_ID, CHANNEL_CODE, DRAFT_TYPE, COPY_TEXT, IMAGE_URL, DECODE(SELECTED_YN, 'Y', 1, 0) AS SELECTED FROM DRAFT WHERE CAMPAIGN_ID IN () ORDER BY CAMPAIGN_ID, DRAFT_TYPE
SELECT h.DRAFT_ID, h.HASHTAG_SEQ, h.HASHTAG FROM DRAFT_HASHTAG h JOIN DRAFT d ON d.DRAFT_ID = h.DRAFT_ID WHERE d.CAMPAIGN_ID IN () ORDER BY h.DRAFT_ID, h.HASHTAG_SEQ

SELECT p.POST_ID, p.DRAFT_ID, d.CAMPAIGN_ID, d.CHANNEL_CODE, d.DRAFT_TYPE, p.POST_STATUS, p.POSTED_AT, NVL(m.LIKE_COUNT, 0) AS LIKE_COUNT, NVL(m.COMMENT_COUNT, 0) AS COMMENT_COUNT, NVL(m.SHARE_COUNT, 0) AS SHARE_COUNT, NVL(m.SAVE_COUNT, 0) AS SAVE_COUNT, NVL(m.REACH_COUNT, 0) AS REACH_COUNT FROM POST p JOIN DRAFT d ON d.DRAFT_ID = p.DRAFT_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT POST_ID, LIKE_COUNT, COMMENT_COUNT, SHARE_COUNT, SAVE_COUNT, REACH_COUNT FROM POST_METRIC WHERE METRIC_ID IN (SELECT MAX(METRIC_ID) FROM POST_METRIC GROUP BY POST_ID)) m ON m.POST_ID = p.POST_ID WHERE d.CAMPAIGN_ID IN () ORDER BY p.POST_ID
SELECT CAMPAIGN_ID, MIN(DUE_AT) AS DUE_AT FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE NOTIFICATION_TYPE = #{type} AND CAMPAIGN_ID IN () GROUP BY CAMPAIGN_ID
mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_CAMPAIGN.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO CAMPAIGN (CAMPAIGN_ID, STORE_ID, GOAL_CODE, CUSTOM_GOAL, INSIGHT_ID, CAMPAIGN_NAME, TARGET_CUSTOMER, TONE_MANNER, EXTRA_NOTE, HASHTAG_YN, CAPTION_YN, AD_IMAGE_YN, CURRENT_STEP, LOCKED_STEP, USAGE_MONTH, CAMPAIGN_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, PUBLISHED_AT) VALUES (#{campaignId}, #{storeId}, #{goalCode}, #{customGoal}, #{insightId}, #{campaignName}, #{targetCustomer}, #{toneManner}, #{extraNote}, ${hashtagOn ? "'Y'" : "'N'"}, ${captionOn ? "'Y'" : "'N'"}, ${imageOn ? "'Y'" : "'N'"}, #{currentStep}, #{lockedStep}, #{usageMonth}, #{campaignStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{publishedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE CAMPAIGN SET GOAL_CODE = #{goalCode}, CUSTOM_GOAL = #{customGoal}, INSIGHT_ID = #{insightId}, CAMPAIGN_NAME = #{campaignName}, TARGET_CUSTOMER = #{targetCustomer}, TONE_MANNER = #{toneManner}, EXTRA_NOTE = #{extraNote}, HASHTAG_YN = ${hashtagOn ? "'Y'" : "'N'"}, CAPTION_YN = ${captionOn ? "'Y'" : "'N'"}, AD_IMAGE_YN = ${imageOn ? "'Y'" : "'N'"}, CURRENT_STEP = #{currentStep}, LOCKED_STEP = #{lockedStep}, CAMPAIGN_STATUS = #{campaignStatus}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt}, PUBLISHED_AT = #{publishedAt} WHERE CAMPAIGN_ID = #{campaignId}
UPDATE CAMPAIGN SET CURRENT_STEP = #{currentStep}, LOCKED_STEP = #{lockedStep} WHERE CAMPAIGN_ID = #{campaignId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CAMPAIGN_CHANNEL (CAMPAIGN_ID, CHANNEL_CODE, CUSTOM_CHANNEL_NAME, CUSTOM_CHANNEL_NOTE, IMAGE_RATIO) VALUES (#{campaignId}, #{channelCode}, #{customChannelName}, #{customChannelNote}, #{imageRatio})

SELECT SEQ_AI_PLAN.NEXTVAL AS AI_PLAN_ID, (SELECT NVL(MAX(VERSION_NO), 0) + 1 FROM AI_PLAN WHERE CAMPAIGN_ID = #{campaignId}) AS VERSION_NO FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO AI_PLAN (AI_PLAN_ID, CAMPAIGN_ID, VERSION_NO, PLAN_SOURCE, DIRECTION, TARGET_ANALYSIS, AGE_GROUP, STRATEGY, TONES, RECOMMENDED_CHANNELS, EXPECTED_EFFECT, REACH, FREQUENCY, DURATION, USER_REQUEST, CONFIRMED_YN, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{aiPlanId}, #{campaignId}, #{versionNo}, #{planSource}, #{direction}, #{targetAnalysis}, #{ageGroup}, #{strategy}, #{tones}, #{recommendedChannels}, #{expectedEffect}, #{reach}, #{frequency}, #{duration}, #{userRequest}, ${confirmed ? "'Y'" : "'N'"}, SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO IMAGE_SETTING (CAMPAIGN_ID, PURPOSE, MAIN_PRODUCT, MOOD, COMPOSITION, BRAND_COLOR_YN, REFERENCE_IMAGE_URL, EXTRA_REQUEST, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{campaignId}, #{purpose}, #{mainProduct}, #{mood}, #{composition}, ${brandColorOn ? "'Y'" : "'N'"}, #{referenceImageUrl}, #{extraRequest}, SYSDATE)
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM DRAFT WHERE CAMPAIGN_ID = #{campaignId}
AND DRAFT_ID NOT IN #{id}
mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_DRAFT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO DRAFT (DRAFT_ID, CAMPAIGN_ID, CHANNEL_CODE, DRAFT_TYPE, COPY_TEXT, IMAGE_URL, SELECTED_YN, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{draftId}, #{campaignId}, #{channelCode}, #{draftType}, #{copyText}, #{imageUrl}, ${selected ? "'Y'" : "'N'"}, SYSDATE)
INSERT INTO DRAFT_HASHTAG (DRAFT_ID, HASHTAG_SEQ, HASHTAG) VALUES (#{draftId}, #{hashtagSeq}, #{hashtag})
SELECT SEQ_POST.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO POST (POST_ID, DRAFT_ID, POST_STATUS, POSTED_AT) VALUES (#{postId}, #{draftId}, #{postStatus}, #{postedAt})

INSERT INTO POST_METRIC (METRIC_ID, POST_ID, LIKE_COUNT, COMMENT_COUNT, SHARE_COUNT, SAVE_COUNT, REACH_COUNT, COLLECTED_AT, COLLECT_METHOD) VALUES (SEQ_POST_METRIC.NEXTVAL, #{postId}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{shareCount}, #{saveCount}, #{reachCount}, #{postedAt}, 'SAMPLE')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INSIGHT_CAMPAIGN WHERE CAMPAIGN_ID = #{campaignId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CAMPAIGN WHERE CAMPAIGN_ID = #{campaignId} AND STORE_ID = #{storeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE CAMPAIGN SET INSIGHT_ID = NULL WHERE STORE_ID = #{storeId}
